run_scan_agent: run the scan agent to navigate StreetLearn panoramas by pano ID and yaw from a tab-separated list file
run_scan_agent_save_images: run the scan agent with save_images flag to capture and save panorama view and graph images as BMP files
run_scan_agent_custom_viewport: run the scan agent with custom width, height, and field_of_view flags for the observation viewport
run_scan_agent_cli: run the scan agent CLI module with required dataset_path and list_pano_ids_yaws arguments
review_scan_agent_loop: review the scan_agent loop function that iterates over pano IDs and yaws to display StreetLearn observations
